mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the copied chromosomes into two nuclei was most worthwhile: the intermediate inset connects spindle action to the chromosome sets each daughter needs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cell growth was the least engaging passage: it established the necessary preparation, but the sole available combination made it predictable.

surprise.text: The final illustration plan extends beyond one division to show a population, including cells retained for further division.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the actin–myosin ring's name and how its components generate constriction were not explained in the supplied prose.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the stem-cell descendants take different paths; this chapter's clear sequence was useful, though its single-option choices offered little decision-making.
